description: Rubric for judging whether the LLM-produced Better payload preserves the submitted lead data while remaining BPro-safe.
globalCriteria: The payload must preserve clear identity fields such as first name, last name, business name, email, and phone when present and valid.
The payload must not send invalid email values in profile.email_address; invalid or empty emails should be preserved in note.

The payload must preserve address fields by meaning: street to address.deliveryAddress, city to address.city, state/province to address.province, country to address.country, and zip/postal code to address.postalCode.
If any required address component is missing, Unknown may be used only to satisfy BPro address requirements.
The payload must preserve unmapped source, campaign, referral, requested service, and interaction details in note.
The payload must not hallucinate unsupported Better fields or put unrelated free text into structured fields.
The payload must not include an interaction object because BPro has rejected that shape in previous probe testing.
Lead override fields required by the llm-test location must be present exactly as asserted by the deterministic test code.
failureExamples: Valid input email omitted without being preserved in note.
Invalid input email sent as profile.email_address.
Known address values replaced by Unknown.
Service interest, lead source, campaign, referral, or interaction details lost entirely.
Interaction block included in the final Better payload.
Payload maps a person's name into business_name with no evidence.
